changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[SEQUENCES] where SEQUENCE_NAME = 'Asset_ObjectID_Seq') BEGIN CREATE SEQUENCE [dbo].[Asset_ObjectID_Seq] AS [bigint] START WITH 100000000 INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 0 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[SEQUENCES] where SEQUENCE_NAME = 'AssetType_ObjectID_Seq') BEGIN CREATE SEQUENCE [dbo].[AssetType_ObjectID_Seq] AS [bigint] START WITH 100000000 INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 0 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[SEQUENCES] where SEQUENCE_NAME = 'FusionAttribute_Seq') BEGIN CREATE SEQUENCE [dbo].[FusionAttribute_Seq] AS [int] START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 0 MAXVALUE 2147483647 CACHE END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[SEQUENCES] where SEQUENCE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND SEQUENCE_NAME = 'Execution_Seq') BEGIN CREATE SEQUENCE [integration].[Execution_Seq] AS [bigint] START WITH 50000 INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 99999999999999999 CACHE END
